annotations.text:
Built on the app's real v6 tokens: ground #070E0D, panel #0B1712, cobalt #2E5CE6, Instrument Serif + Figtree. The four backgrounds are the app's own illustrations, plus a still from the ambient loop in the hero (that one becomes the looping video in the build).

Progress is the app's TickMeter, not a bar. The Move / Earn / Use pills are live on both page artboards.
